steps.title: Getting started
steps.text: Talk to Sylas south of Taverley (north of the Witch's house).
[Accept Quest]

steps.title: Grimgnash
steps.text: Head up the east side of White Wolf Mountain near the Burthorpe mine entrance and talk to Grimgnash.

actions.text: I heard you were a great and mighty Griffin!
There once was graveyard filled with undead.
There lived a skeleton named Skullrot.
Skullrot hungrily grabbed the gnome's hair.
Started to strangle the poor gnome.

steps.text: Once he is sleeping, take a Feather from next to the nest.
Go back to Sylas and talk to him.

steps.title: Rupert
steps.text: Head to the tower directly south-east of Goblin Village.
Go around the south-east side, climb over the crumbling wall, and talk into the drainpipe.
Talk into the drainpipe again.

actions.text: I could try and climb up
Is there anything up there that can help?

postconditions.text: Not really, old spoon. There's not much up here except for me and my beard. Ha ha!

steps.text: Climb up Rupert's beard.
Talk to Rupert.
Right-click climb down Rupert.
Talk to Miazrqa, located over the crumbling wall and to the north of the tower.

actions.text: I need a key for the house.
I should be off, I think.

postconditions.text: Very well. Good luck with finding my pendant.

steps.title: The pendant
steps.text: Head to the Witch's house south of Taverley, the building next to Sylas.

Open the main door.
  • Look under the Potted plant to the left of the main door of the witch's house to obtain a key if not given by the princess.
Climb down stairs (cellar bulkhead) and search the crate near the piano for leather gloves. You may need to search multiple times.
Whilst wearing the leather gloves, open the gate and search the Music stand.

Play the piano in the first room (refer to the music sheet pictured right).
  • The notes 'EFEDC' are played on the right hand (upper) side and the notes 'AEGA' are played on the left hand (lower) side.
Right-click Search the now-opened piano.

Make two shrink-me-quick potions.
  • Combine vial of water and clean tarromin.
  • Add shrunk ogleroot.
  • Repeat.
Go upstairs and head into the small room leading to the garden.
Drink one of the potions next to the mouse hole and glyph.

While in the mouse hole, follow these directions:
  • Run north past the first mouse, find the set of the nails on the eastern wall and climb up them.
  • Go south-west, and climb up the nails on the northern wall.
  • Climb up the nails on the south wall in the room.
  • Run to the north-east corner, and climb down the nails on the eastern wall.
  • Run north, and climb up the nails on the eastern wall.
  • Pickup the pendant at the end of the next hallway.
After taking Miazrqa's pendant, leave the mouse hole either by teleporting to Taverley, or Home teleport to Falador, or going back through the entrance.
Talk to Miazrqa.
Talk to Rupert to get Rupert's helmet.
If you need another shrunken oglreroot, you can kill an Experiment No. 2 down the manhole near the entrance to the witch's house, or pick one up from the pile in the room with the experiments.

steps.title: The beanstalk
steps.text: Talk to Sylas.
Plant the magic beans in the Farming patch next to Sylas and water it using a watering can.
Climb the beanstalk and kill Glod.
Take the golden goblin, climb down the stalk on southern sides and give it to Sylas.

Right-click Use the other shrinking potion on the beanstalk.
  • Careful not to drink it!
Chop the beanstalk.
Talk to Sylas.
Quest complete!
